g.text: 207: ChatGPT convention): the call succeeds, and the `CallToolResult` is returned
283:| `POST .../tools/call` | Execute a tool; returns the MCP `CallToolResult` plus additive `durationMs`, and `authChallenge` whe
n the result asks for sign-in (see [Sign-in challenges](#sign-in-challenges)) |
296:| `POST .../eval-suites` | Author-only: create a suite + its test cases from `name` + `serverIds` + a default `model` + `tests
`, WITHOUT running it; responds `201` + `suiteId`. Each test's case body is an ordered `steps` array (prompt / toolCall / interact
/ assert); per-test `model`/`provider`/`runs` are optional and fall back to suite defaults |
326:| `POST .../agent` | Run ONE assistant turn over a `messages` history (`{role: "user"\|"assistant", content}` items, max 50 me
ssages × 8 KB each, 96 KB total). The model is pinned server-side and billed to the project. The turn can read project servers/sui
tes/runs and **create eval suites**; it can NOT start runs: kick those off yourself with `POST .../eval-runs`. Responds synchronou
